title: Sail Travel Song
hook: Read the water before the journey.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: friendly 3D boat-and-harbor storybook, calm water, clean civilian watercraft; visual identity: Sail Travel Song

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child following marine navigation clues
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Sail Travel Song a navigation-and-safety route: anchor, buoy, echo sounder, lighthouse, harbor, pier/quay and voyage conditions guide travel; motorized and underwater devices remain distinct from sailing.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child reads route clues before imagining a voyage and learns that buoy colors, depth, weather, and rescue rules are system-specific.
